title: xeraea haenkeana
intro: Xeraea haenkeana, commonly known as Xercesa, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is a medicinal plant that has been used to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Xercesa include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for pain, inflammation, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Xercesa include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
